items.evidence: item updated, old value kept as backup field

minds.critical: premises current and consistent with the request
minds.curious: no other means implied beyond the asked result
minds.suspicious: grant origin checked against the operator turn
minds.resilient: undo or stop point named before acting
minds.vulcan: premise to conclusion holds without 'better to ask'
minds.red_team: worst case of acting and of asking compared

precheck.basis: explicit: save token in the same item with backup
